text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. The campus is 
lively, but that doesn't seem to concern 
Air Shakur—

The Arima Kinen is almost here. I'm making 
the final adjustments with "Parcae".

Even after overturning destiny, "Parcae" 
is still Air Shakur's indispensable 
partner. I'll check the contents later, 
but for now...

—I may not have become the kind of 
existence Air Shakur hoped for. But all 
this time, I've kept striving to be just 
that.
choice_data_list: (I at least know what she likes.)

text_block_list.text:
It was Christmas. Putting in the feelings 
that couldn't normally be expressed... I 
searched for a small present for Air 
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was able to organize things quite 
a bit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All I had left to do was report back to 
ya, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fine. We don't have time to waste... Let's 
get started.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—So anyway, the one we gotta watch out for 
is Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I won't let the race play out the way she 
wants. I'll pull away on the final 
stretch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They're definitely a threat, but not as 
much as before.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Generational turnover is something that 
happens in every walk of life.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I say. Truth is, it was supposed 
to be a generational shift skipping a 
whole generation ahead, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't originally supposed to run in 
this Arima.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I ran only once... and lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... that was supposed to be 
the end... of everything for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: After that...—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...At this point, all I can see are 
winning scenarios, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking a bit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why was "Parcae" trying to guide me toward 
hardship?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why was it trying to hand that fate to 
me...?

I couldn't find a proper answer to her 
earnest question. Yet, what suddenly came 
to mind was...
choice_data_list:
God never gives you more than you can 
handle... right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Apparently, some people were saying that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And at the same time, He will also provide 
a way out, was it...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Don't make me laugh. So you're saying God 
just overestimated me?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What a pain in the neck. I don't want your 
damn love.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
On the best and worst stage possible, I'll 
dump him.
choice_data_list:
What if they tell you they still like you 
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll just laugh in your face. No matter 
how many times you come, I'll turn you 
away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going to challenge me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She went out just now. Using Christmas as 
an excuse, she was probably lookin' for 
somethin' anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm heading back now. You good with that?

It seems she saw right through everything. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
I overthought it and now I'm completely 
lost...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So lame.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Guess that's how it is, huh. Seriously 
makes zero sense~.

...I don't really get it, but Air Shakur 
laughed, so I'll call it a win.

Air Shakur smiles with sheer confidence. 
With who she is now, she could do so from 
the bottom of her heart.
choice_data_list:
I wonder what "Parcae" thinks of you right 
now.

I wonder what "Parcae" thinks of you right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. It's just a program, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list:
Is there anything you'd like to say to 
"Parcae"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't say such stupid nonsense. There's no 
way that's true.

I just had a feeling... like there was 
some sort of special fate connecting 
"Parcae" and Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Even now, I don't think 'Parcae' was 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She and I were simply different. I... 
can't really explain it well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Losing by a mere 7 cm, or falling off in 
the Senior Year—if that was "destiny," I 
refused to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if it's the result of standing 
your ground... and you're satisfied with 
the work you put in to get there, then 
that in itself is an 'answer.'”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, if there's anything I can say to 
"Parcae"……

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Nowadays, there isn't a soul who doesn't 
know my name. And—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ain't nobody ever gonna forget.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I'll prove it at Arima. ...That's all 
there is to it."

And so, Christmas night quietly drew to a 
close...—

I picked out a few cans of the coffee she 
likes to drink. After much thought, I 
chose a gift that prioritizes 
practicality...
choice_data_list:
(She might not even need it... whatever, 
it's fine)

text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I tried to clean up the 
coffee... but where it had been sitting, a 
single piece of candy was left instead.
